provider: hetzner object storage (as the kms alternative to storage box)

free_tier.stated: no free allowance: a EUR 6.49 a month base price (excl. VAT) includes 1 TB of storage and 1 TB of egress; storage and egress beyond it are billed pay-as-you-go

egress.terms: the base price includes 1 TB of egress a month for the whole account, accumulated hourly (at most 1.1160 TB in a 31-day month) and not carried over to the next month; ingress, internal traffic within the eu-central network zone and S3 operations such as PUT, GET and DELETE are free, but the egress those operations cause is billed
egress.price_per_tb: EUR 1.0000 per TB beyond the included quota, excl. VAT

interface_detail: S3-compatible API at the fsn1, nbg1 and hel1 your-objectstorage.com endpoints

identity_cost.detail: before an order is processed the account may have to be verified with a copy of a valid government-issued ID (ID card or passport) or with an advance payment from the holder's own credit card; registrants are asked not to use a free email address or a VPN service

reliability_note: The guide that surfaced it states the comparison directly.
